text:
Sadbarg Qodirova, the kiln-log clerk, stayed after the firing at the yard in Dushanbe and copied the carbon before it dried. Vendor Sarioz Gauge House. Bill SG-3184. They want 1,460.75 somoni for the thermocouple that arrived taped to a plank. The only date on the page is 11 August 2026. STAMP: SANJIDA, red, walking into the margin. She pencilled лутфан имрӯз because the driver would not wait on the ramp. Old docket SG-8830 was a probe we sent back and is not this charge. The copy roller split cra-
te across the crease. Grease thumb in the box, no buyer code typed anywhere on this slip.

vendor.instruction: Shop that sent the kiln slip

bill_no.instruction: Bill number printed on the slip

total.instruction: Money total copied from the slip

buyer_code.instruction: Buyer code if one was typed

text:
Orazgeldi Nuryyev, loom fitter, wrote this after the carpet line in Ashgabat snapped a shuttle just before dusk. Vendor Yelken Belt Loft. Bill YB-5520. Margin charges, in the order he heard them: shuttle brake, loom belt, night callout. The figure copied beside the stamp is 890.40 manat. Issued 6 July 2026 with 17 credit days, and he left the due day off the page on purpose. A short line in Turkmen says töleg wagtynda. The tear splits sha-
ft onto the next line. Prior quote YB-4475 was another loom and stays unmarked. Oil smear, stamp crooked, corner chewed.

bill_no.instruction: Bill number on the loft copy

charges.instruction: Each charge named in the margin

pay_by.instruction: Issue date plus the credit days

text:
Lucie Boula, sample runner, carried the cooler from the lab shed to the quay at Noumea while the squall sat on the reef. Vendor Anse Vata Runners. Bill AV-5528. The note opens on 11 March 2027 and allows 18 days, yet the day that follows that wait is not written. Copied fee 734.60 francs for the cooler and the ferry hop. Blotter French: règlement dès que possible. STAMP: NICKEL, red, half across the crease. The pen skipped and split coo-
ler. Sister slip AV-7731 was a harbour quote she refused. No customs entry is named on this page at all.

vendor.instruction: Runner who billed the quay job

bill_no.instruction: Bill number on the sample note

settle_on.instruction: Start date plus the allowed days

entry_code.instruction: Customs entry if the note carried one

text:
Heiarii Teriitahi, ice runner, counted bags before dawn at the co-op shed in Papeete while the lagoon was still dark. Vendor Motu Ice & Salt. Bill FA-2633. Labour is 4.5 hours times 37.20 francs, and that product was left off the carbon. Hatch closed at 6:15 pm. The date line says 19 October 2026. Loaded: flake ice, salt sack, crate liner. French scrawl: glace déjà fondue. The perforation splits lin-
er. Old total 240.15 from a cancelled run is still faint and is not this job. Salt crust on the stamp and the hinge.

vendor.instruction: Cold room that wrote the ticket

bill_no.instruction: Bill number on the ice ticket

text:
Fabiola Maduro, winch rigger, wrote this on the pontoon at Oranjestad after the drum seized in the swell. Vendor Paardenbaai Wire Works. Bill PB-7712. She logged the call as 3 November 2026 4:40 pm. Gross on the slate is 612.80 florin and the credit slip says 148.35, but the difference was never copied onto the page. Service date underneath: 28 October 2026. Papiamento in the margin: fabor paga awe. Grease splits win-
ch across the smear. Earlier quote 508.90 was a different sheave and remains unmarked. Stamp BAY tilted, rope fibre in the ink.

vendor.instruction: Yard that sent the winch bill

bill_no.instruction: Bill number on the pontoon copy

balance.instruction: Slate gross minus the credit slip

served.instruction: Service date under the log line

text:
Kenisha Deterville, tally clerk, counted the afternoon load at the warehouse in Castries while rain hit the zinc roof. Vendor Vigie Bond Stores. Bill VN-6408. Three amounts on the slate: 52.30, 18.45, and 27.60, and nobody wrote what they add up to. Lines beside them: nutmeg bags, mace tins, crate straps. An old figure 215.70 was quoted on a rejected card and is not marked. Docket date 22 September 2026. Kwéyòl in the corner: tanpri péyé. The staple tears do-
cket. Violet stamp smudged, drip at the edge.

vendor.instruction: Bond house that issued the docket

bill_no.instruction: Bill number on the warehouse docket

lines.instruction: Each goods line named beside the amounts

text:
Kingstown yard, carbon three. Job KV-3084 was called for Grenadine Cold Store after the night load on the dock compressor started to warm. I changed the burnt contactor and taped the pitted lead that kept arcing when the fan kicked. Time on the board is 8 hours at 73.25 an hour, and I will multiply it back at the desk. Old quote QK-19 still says 540.00; the clerk can bin that slip. Finished 14 March 2026. No purchase order was pinned to the docket. Foreman scrawled hold across the stamp RECEIVED. The sheet tore at contac-
tor and I recopied that word in pencil. Marlon Cato.

job_code.instruction: Job code printed on the docket

customer.instruction: Customer the night call was for

labour.instruction: Hours on the board multiplied by the hourly rate

purchase_order.instruction: Purchase order pinned to the docket

text:
Basseterre, Friday rain on the market roof. Job SK-2207 at the parish cistern. I lifted a seized gate valve, a cracked brass union, and a soaked hemp gasket out of the header before the torch would sit still. Replacement pipe is 4 lengths at 137.25 each. I will multiply that out back at the desk. Quote BK-6 still reads 480.00 from the dry season, which is the wrong figure. Cut-in done 3 June 2026. A neighbour pencilled eau claire in the margin and underlined it twice. Stamp SMEARED. My glove shows a scorch at the th-
umb. Elise Pemberton left the dog asleep by the tap.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the cistern slip

fittings.instruction: Each fitting lifted out of the header

pipe.instruction: Lengths of pipe multiplied by the price of one

text:
Nassau harbour shop, bay two, after the squall. Job NH-6184 on the pilot launch that sat idle through Christmas. I found salt crust on the casing, a pitted impeller, and a loose foot under the raw-water pump. Gross on the slip is 860.40 and the yard credit is 125.15. The subtraction is still on a scrap at home. Opened 8 January 2026 and closed 2 February 2026. The February chit said 640.00, and that was a different boat. Margin note, muy salado. Stamp HARBOUR. The log broke at impell-
er where the nib snagged. Dario Rolle.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the harbour slip

faults.instruction: Each fault found on the pump

balance.instruction: Gross on the slip minus the yard credit

layover.instruction: How many days the launch job stayed open

text:
Hamilton sail loft, upstairs over the lane. Job BM-5520 for the pilot gig before the weekend start. Still on the slate: coil the spare warp, grease the windlass, paint the bitts, and log the soundings. I dated the board 19 August 2026. The wharf permit was never handed up, so that box stays empty. An older jacket in the drawer is marked BM-17 and belongs to another gig. Stamp NIL. The clerk wrote vu beside a tear. The warp line split as wa-
rp where the nib caught the fibre. June Outerbridge hung the board back on the nail.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the loft board

tasks.instruction: Each task still on the slate

wharf_permit.instruction: Wharf permit handed up with the board

text:
Road Town, the small survey desk by the jetty. Job VG-4071 covered the channel marks east of the customs house, the ones the ferry masters keep missing at dusk. We opened the book on 6 May 2026 and closed it on 28 May 2026 once the last buoy was sighted from the east pile. The margin on this chit stays blank. The old folder VG-88 is a different jetty and should stay in the drawer. Stamp SIGHTED. Humidity ran the ink, and the page tore at sig-
hted. Kenyatta Fahie left this chit on the spike for the morning clerk.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the survey chit

opened.instruction: Date the survey book was opened

closed.instruction: Date the survey book was closed

span.instruction: How many days passed between the two dates

text:
Bridgetown, bakery lane behind the careenage, before the shops rolled up. Job BB-8519 for the dawn round. I carried a yeast tub, a salt sack, and a butter block up the stair while the van idled. The three slips read 182.40, 67.15, and 94.80. The adding up can wait until I reach the office. Delivered 21 November 2026. Last month the board wrote 410.00 for a different oven, so leave that figure alone. Stamp WET. The pencil snapped on sta-
ir. Althea Clarke waited under the awning until the clerk initialled the carbon.

job_code.instruction: Job code on the dawn note

goods.instruction: Each item carried up the stair

text:
Lina Vatu, berth clerk on the late shift, scratched this on the back of a damp docket while the launch Mako waited in Port Vila. A shaft bush has to be priced before dawn and the chand lers will not agree. She caught the shouts in the order they crossed the wharf:
860
415
290
640
510
735
380
955
STAMP: CANCELLED slip PV-188, the old quote of 700 was ruled out in red pencil. Under it she wrote "plis sevem kopi" and the crease split the word bush-
ing so the tail sits on the next line. Diesel on the corner, no signature, carbon faint.

place.instruction: Town written on the damp docket

figure.instruction: Harbour price halfway between the two middle quotes

text:
Morning at the Monte Cafe shed, Sao Tome. Paulo Mendes, cocoa grader, weighed the wet sacks before the fer-
ry horn and kept only the second look at the jumping scale: 320, 80, 250, 150. A drawer card still says 275 and he will not reuse it. He muttered "nota de hoje, sem falta" while the photo OCR split "grad er". STAMP: AG-19, purple, half off the page, coffee ring through the corner, no second initial.

figure.instruction: Sack weight halfway between the two central readings

text:
Ruth Warren, radio operator, copied spare-bin counts for the cliff shed at Adamstown on 9 April 2026. Six bins, counted by tor ch because the genera-
tor coughed: 160 40 210 90 70 180. A faded chit underneath still reads bin total 150, which she refuses. Margin note "copie recue". STAMP: PITC-04, purple, half off the edge, carbon smeared, no countersign.

logged.instruction: Day the bins were counted by torch

figure.instruction: Spare count halfway between the two middle bins

text:
The jetty book at Flying Fish Cove is kept by Sera Iman, tally clerk. One landing per line, ink runny, and "sudah kira" pencilled over the column. She left the latest three in the locked flap and will not copy them here. The tall y column starts:
2026-04-02|41
2026-04-05|46
2026-04-08|52
2026-04-11|58
STAMP: prior card FC-17 showed 37 and was rejected. The page tear splits land-
ing across the crease. No skipper signature, salt on the margin.

place.instruction: Cove named in the tally book

series.instruction: Landing counts still in the locked flap

text:
Rain on the awnings, and Omar Willems, market inspector, walked the morning stalls in Philipsburg. He logged one crate count each visit and folded the last pair under the carbon. "Graag bevestigen" sits on the Dutch line he never translates. The mar ket sheet reads:
2026-04-03|33
2026-04-07|37
2026-04-12|44
2026-04-16|49
STAMP: clipboard tag PB-29 claimed 81 crates and he marked it wrong. A staple hole breaks inspec-
tor in half. Pencil smear, no second initial, awning drip on the corner.

series.instruction: Stall counts on the folded carbon

text:
Shutter up, kettle not yet boiled. Celia Brooks, clinic runner at the morning window in Saint John's, writes how many people were still outside. She muttered "likkle line long" and locked three later mornings in the tin. The clin ic slate shows:
2026-05-02|28
2026-05-04|36
2026-05-07|43
2026-05-11|51
STAMP: yesterday board SJ-3 said 95 and the nurse struck it. The hole punch tears shutt-
er across the middle. Blue ink, no stamp date, a thumbprint on the lower corner.

place.instruction: Town on the clinic shutter note

series.instruction: Queue counts locked in the tin

text:
The harbour desk in Torshavn was still wet when I came on. I am Sigrid Jacobsen, late clerk, and Arne Poulsen would not step off the mat. His case TF-3184 is a cabin bag that returned light from the evening sailing. He counted off a wool cap, a tide chart, and a brass key, one tap on the blotter for each, and he refused the stool. I set the date at 14 March 2026. Older docket TF-2201 is another cabin on another night and it stays shut in the side drawer. No courier tag was pinned to this leaf. STAMP: INTAKE. Under his breath, takk fyri. The carbon split cab
in across the tear, and I left that word in two pieces.

case_code.instruction: Case code on this harbour slip

missing_items.instruction: Each thing he said was missing from the bag

courier_tag.instruction: Courier tag if one was pinned

text:
Noon at the archive cloakroom, Punta Arenas. Mateo Riquelme here, still shaking rain off a cuff, after Lorena Vidal pushed a damp bundle across the counter. Her ticket PA-7742 holds a torn sleeve, a salt crust along the chart tube, and a loose clasp that had already sprung once. I entered 3 July 2026 in the corner. Card PA-1108 below it is a school visit from earlier in the season and is not her bundle. No freight-office slip was with the papers. STAMP: GUARDADO. She nodded and said queda anotado. The ribbon then prin
ted the last word on two lines, ghost and all, and I left both.

faults.instruction: Each fault noted on the bundle

freight_ref.instruction: Freight office reference, if any was clipped

text:
Sokoto motor park, north gate ledger. Halima Danjuma writing, records clerk, because driver Musa Garba could not move the gearbox lorry off bay two. I opened docket SK-5521 on 9 June 2026. We released that lorry on 2 July 2026, after the weld cooled and he signed the margin with a blunt pencil. Card SK-3088 underneath is a different driver and a different week; do not clip it here. The folder has no insurer slip at all. STAMP: YARD. He said na gode and smeared a thumbprint on the edge. The machine jumped and split rel
ease, which I did not retype.

docket_code.instruction: Yard docket on this wait note

opened_on.instruction: Date the wait note was opened

yard_days.instruction: Days from the open date to the release date

insurer_slip.instruction: Insurer reference, if a slip was in the folder

text:
Bishkek, boiler counter, school annex. I am Jyrgal Bektenov and the kettle was hissing the whole time I wrote. Job BK-6417 is a gasket at 18.40 som, a flue brush at 7.25 som, and a pilot jet at 26.10 som. I stopped short of adding them; the foot of the page is empty on purpose. Voided slip BK-2290 is last winter and must stay out of this job. Corner date August 19, 2026. STAMP: KASSIR. The caretaker Elnura said рахмат and left. Faded ribbon broke ann
ex over the fold.

job_code.instruction: Workshop job code on this slip

parts.instruction: Each part set on the counter

written_on.instruction: Date in the corner of the slip

text:
Malabo port radio, afternoon net. Ines Ndong on the desk, holding a scratch sheet for coxswain Elias Mba, whose first reply dissolved in static. Call MB-4176 left in the locker a rain cape, a lamp glass, and a coil of rope. I opened it 5 May 2026 and closed it 28 May 2026 once a call sign finally came through clean. MB-8024 is an archived call for another boat and another watch. No clinic chit was on the board. STAMP: RADIO. He got out recibido, gracias, barely. My pen tore lock
er at the crease and I did not copy the sheet again.

call_code.instruction: Dispatch call code on the sheet

locker_gear.instruction: Each piece that stayed in the locker

held_days.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

clinic_chit.instruction: Clinic chit, if one was pinned to the board

text:
Honiara wharf shed, the light already going. Ruth Mae, outboard clerk, for fisher Peter Sua, up from the reef passage with a wet sack. Job HN-2638 took a shear pin, a fuel hose, and a split ring. Bench time was 4 hours at 13.15 an hour, and I never multiplied the two on this card. Somebody had pencilled “charge the old rate of 61.40” along the edge; that quote is a discarded chit, not this job. HN-1504 belongs to his cousin and that dinghy. Date 11 November 2027. STAMP: SHED. He laughed tanggio tumas. Carbon slip split din
ghy in half.

job_code.instruction: Shed job code for this fisher

fittings.instruction: Each fitting he set on the bench

labour.instruction: Hours on the bench times the hourly rate
